newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's net foreign reserves rise to $9.89 bln.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's net foreign reserves rise to $9.89 bln.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves stood at $9.89 billion as of March 7, the latest date for which figures are available, the central bank said Monday.
Net reserves were up $76 million from levels as of February 28 and were up 27.8 percent from levels as of March 8, 1996.
Gross international reserves stood at $10.66 billion as of March 7, a $792 million rise from the end of February.
A sharp influx of foreign reserves was one of the factors that prompted the government to declare a state of economic emergency in January.
As of March 7, net foreign reserves had fallen $4.3 million since year-end 1996.
